MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink bundle and Echo lighting kit give my Alexa setup new uses: connected home security and voice-controlled lighting.",
    "The USB extension cables fit my repeated use of computer peripherals because they would make connecting my card reader and adapters more convenient."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The older Echo Dot, first-generation Show 5, and Fire TV Stick repeat functions covered by devices I recently interacted with, so they give me little reason to choose them now.",
    "The Ring charger requires battery packs I have no demonstrated need for, while the earbuds do not connect to a current need in my recent activity.",
    "The Show 8 offers a larger screen, but my recent Show 5 and stand already address that use, and the auto-renewing trial makes it less appealing."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in Alexa devices seems to have been taken as interest in almost any Echo or Fire TV device, regardless of whether it adds something useful.",
    "My electronics activity seems to have been treated as a reason to offer earbuds, even though my recent choices point toward home equipment and practical computer accessories."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent device generations and matching accessories matter: the fourth-generation Dot and second-generation Show 5 make older versions less useful to me.",
    "Compatibility and a clear purpose matter for accessories; USB extensions serve devices I already use, whereas a Ring charger has no evident device to support.",
    "I am more interested in adding a useful capability to my setup than duplicating one I recently addressed."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my Alexa and computer-accessory interests but often missed whether an item adds a useful capability to my current setup."
}
